heroTitle: Everything you need, in one place
heroBody: A working storefront for a conversation about personalization.
inboxEmptyHint: Send one from a Dengage campaign or journey and press Refresh.
inboxStarting: Connecting this browser to Dengage. Press Refresh in a moment.
inboxNoSdk: The inbox needs the Dengage application, which is not loaded on this page.
inboxError: Dengage could not return this inbox. The console has the reason.
accountSignInBody: Continue as an existing contact by entering their contact key. This storefront identifies a contact, it does not check a password.
accountKeyHint: Type the rest of the key. Every contact in this demo starts with the text shown.
accountInvalid: Add the rest of the key after {prefix}
accountSignedInBody: Everything you do from here is recorded against this contact. Open the contact in Dengage to watch it arrive.
accountRegisterBody: Create an account and your contact record, with email and SMS permissions, appears in Dengage as you submit it.
launcherBody: Every Dengage on-site capability, fired on demand. Press one and it appears on this page.
refBody: This browser's identifiers, for pasting into Dengage.
gestureExitIntent: Move the pointer out of the top of the window. Desktop only.
inlineElsewhere: This slot is on another page. Open it and fire from there.
recoBody: Five strategies, all computed from this demo's own catalogue, so they are always the right vertical.
eventsBody: Send a storefront event and watch it land in Dengage.
footerNote: A fictional storefront built for a sales conversation. It carries real product names and is not the named brand's own site.
